job.description: N17, the loop, not the judge's accuracy: the real run on seeds 4101-4105. Trains rw-peer, rw-j10 and rw-j05 (the rungs the calibration's rule chose, --rungs) at full length. Re-measures N13's n80-rw, N16's rw-oracle, N12's sub20 and clean, and N14's sub10, sub05, sub025 and sub0125 of each seed (read from the n13_signal, n16_judge, n12_bottleneck and n14_dose Drive folders) on the held-out tail's windows 1-512. It first runs the setup checks; if any fails, it stops before training. NEEDS AN A100: before Run all, choose Runtime > Change runtime type > A100 GPU. On any other GPU it stops before training. About 60 minutes. Resumable: if a session ends, choose Run all again and finished work is skipped.
